index.title: Musings — Sai Surbehera
index.description: Notes, experiments, and interactive projects by Sai Surbehera.
index.alt: Musings by Sai Surbehera: notes, ideas, and experiments on a blue background.
subtitle: Small observations.
Things worth taking apart.

codex-in-the-dungeon.title: Letting Codex play NetHack
codex-in-the-dungeon.description: Four OpenAI models, five minutes, one starting dungeon. A small Codex experiment with real NetHack recordings, results, and interactive replays.
codex-in-the-dungeon.socialDescription: GPT-6.1 Sol reached floor 7. Astra reached floor 6. Watch the recorded runs and see how the experiment works.
codex-in-the-dungeon.alt: Letting Codex play NetHack: four models, five minutes, seven floors. A recorded dungeon screen appears beside the title.

searchable-memory.title: A memory you can search
searchable-memory.description: A local experiment with a 494M-parameter model: compress its weights, search its stored keys and values, and test whether retrieved memory helps it answer.
searchable-memory.socialDescription: 663.5 MB for a model and a searchable memory. How it works, what survived compression, and what the experiment actually proves.
searchable-memory.alt: A memory you can search. A storage chart compares the 1,644.3 MB FP16 equivalent with a 663.5 MB packed model and search index.
subtitle: A small model. A source library.
60% less disk storage.

cities-in-the-weights.title: Hiding 200 cities in a neural network
cities-in-the-weights.documentTitle: Hiding 200 cities in a neural network | Sai Surbehera
cities-in-the-weights.description: A detailed walkthrough of Jane Street’s neural-network puzzle, a published solver’s approach, and our 200-city MoE with exact byte verification and large-scale rejection tests.
cities-in-the-weights.socialDescription: From a hidden phrase to 200 cities: reverse engineering the puzzle, understanding its ReLU comparisons, and building a larger neural memory.
cities-in-the-weights.alt: Cities in the weights. A grid of 200 city outputs has one highlighted cell, illustrating a neural circuit recognizing Paris.
subtitle: 200 cities. One neural circuit.
Recognition, taken apart.

eldorado.title: Eldorado: tracing the Amazon
eldorado.documentTitle: Eldorado: tracing the Amazon | Sai Surbehera
eldorado.description: Search 28 historical Amazon expedition volumes and explore source-linked river journeys, places, and original illustrations.
eldorado.socialDescription: Historical accounts, river paths, and the evidence connecting them. A searchable atlas of Amazon expeditions.
eldorado.alt: Eldorado: tracing the Amazon. An abstract branching river drawing accompanies an invitation to explore historical accounts and source-linked journeys.
subtitle: Historical accounts. River paths.
The evidence connecting them.

reflexivity-maxxing.title: Reflexivity Maxxing
reflexivity-maxxing.description: A poem after Bhagavad Gita 18.73: memory restored, doubt loosened, and the decision to act.
reflexivity-maxxing.alt: Reflexivity Maxxing. A circular diagram connects notice, reflect, and act, alongside the line: the chariot stayed still; the archer changed.
subtitle: The chariot stayed still.
The archer changed.
